components.name: Scale Bar
components.description: Progress readout cut into ten graduations.

narrative.overview: Cool glass-white ground, teal-black ink, one disciplined accent, and content laid out as plain labelled rows rather than boxes. Calm, precise and quietly playful.
keyCharacteristics: Flat rows and hairlines instead of cards; at most one level of container.
Teal-black ink on cool glass-white, with a single accent per moment.
Progress is a micrometer scale bar, cut into ten graduations.
Display type is tight and confident; body type is plain and readable.
Drawn, colorful icons are the only ornament; chrome carries none.

rules.name: The No Purple Rule
rules.body: Indigo, violet and fuchsia are remapped in the Tailwind theme to teal, steel blue and pink. Nothing renders purple.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Eosin pink is used on at most one element per screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Never put a small label above a heading.

rules.name: The No Nesting Rule
rules.body: A bordered or filled container never contains another bordered or filled container.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No drop shadows on rows, panels or buttons.

dos: Do group content with hairlines and whitespace; use a box only for a single self-contained object.
Do show progress with the scale bar and a count in text.
Do keep type in Newsreader (headings) and Instrument Sans (everything else), sentence case, weights 400 to 600.
Do keep the page quiet so the drawn icons, lesson scenes and ATP rewards stand out.
Do keep tap targets at least 44px and body contrast at 4.5:1 or better.
donts: Don't nest cards, tiles or chips inside other boxes.
Don't use purple, violet or indigo, or any gradient on text, panels or buttons.
Don't put a small label above a heading, or use all-caps labels.
Don't use a colored left or right border thicker than 1px on a row or panel.
Don't add chunky 3D buttons, hard offset shadows, glass blur or glow.
Don't invent stats, testimonials or user counts to fill space.
